description: This file contains utility functions for rounding storage size requests to specific allocation units, tailored for cloud provider disk provisioning in Kubernetes.

methods.name: RoundUpToGiB
methods.description: Rounds up a resource.Quantity to the nearest GiB (gibibyte) size.

methods.name: RoundUpToMB
methods.description: Rounds up a resource.Quantity to the nearest MB (megabyte) size.

methods.name: RoundUpToMiB
methods.description: Rounds up a resource.Quantity to the nearest MiB (mebibyte) size.

methods.name: RoundUpToKB
methods.description: Rounds up a resource.Quantity to the nearest KB (kilobyte) size.

methods.name: RoundUpToKiB
methods.description: Rounds up a resource.Quantity to the nearest KiB (kibibyte) size.

methods.name: RoundUpToB
methods.description: Rounds up a resource.Quantity to bytes.

methods.name: RoundUpToGiBInt
methods.description: Rounds up a resource.Quantity to GiB and returns an int, with overflow check.

methods.name: RoundUpToMBInt
methods.description: Rounds up a resource.Quantity to MB and returns an int, with overflow check.

methods.name: RoundUpToMiBInt
methods.description: Rounds up a resource.Quantity to MiB and returns an int, with overflow check.

methods.name: RoundUpToKBInt
methods.description: Rounds up a resource.Quantity to KB and returns an int, with overflow check.

methods.name: RoundUpToKiBInt
methods.description: Rounds up a resource.Quantity to KiB and returns an int, with overflow check.

methods.name: RoundUpToGiBInt32
methods.description: Rounds up a resource.Quantity to GiB and returns an int32, with overflow check.
